name: Magnification-driven B-spline Interpolation
aliases: Least-square resampling of f(x) on a basis of non-uniform B-splines
definition: A spatial interpolation technique for homography, projection, and backprojection operations that adapts to local magnification factors to reduce edge artifacts and aliasing compared to linear interpolation.
summary: Magnification-driven B-spline interpolation is a spatial resampling technique that adapts to local magnification factors to reduce edge artifacts and aliasing in volume rendering.
